name: Soft Sourdough Dinner Rolls
instructions: 07:30 — Melt butter, milk, sugar, and salt over low heat. Cool to room temp.
08:00 — Add flour and active starter to cooled butter mix. Stir until combined. Cover, rest 1 hour.
09:00 — Perform 3 sets of stretch and fold, 30 min apart. After final set, rise 2 hours or until 50% larger.
12:00 — Divide into 12 pieces (~65g each). Shape into balls. Arrange in greased baking dish. Cover, rise 3–4 hours.
16:00 — Preheat oven to 375°F (190°C). Bake 25–30 min until golden. Internal temp: 190°F.
Brush tops with melted butter. Serve.
notes: Personal note: top oven @ 365° / 25 min. Freeze before baking: shape, freeze, thaw in fridge overnight, rise 3–4 hr. Make ahead: refrigerate shaped rolls up to 36–48 hr; rise 2–3 hr before baking. Reheat at 350°F / 15–20 min tented with foil.
